description: A University College Dublin researcher publishes two Excel workbooks of European cross-border electricity transmission links. Zenodo lists the release under CC BY 4.0. The record describes existing interconnector capacity, future expansion candidates from 2030–2050, project investment cost and whether each link is overhead, subsea or mixed. One workbook aggregates potential; the other organises it by year. The source distinguishes more mature real projects from conceptual links expected after 2040. These tables can support European transmission-expansion and cross-border-flow simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this PECD1 interconnector extract. Coverage is between countries in the PECD1 region; within-country grids are explicitly absent. A limitation is that conceptual capacities and costs are uncertain and should not be treated as approved construction. ENTSO-E and TYNDP are cited as upstream sources, with their own update cycles. No workbook was downloaded or capacity total checked.
